data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* code_version: bed2cd519c7a8bf20ccbf645fe2ceb87ab8d219b
* hook: shim-refs-check (.pre-commit-config.yaml:48), plugins/dso/scripts/check-shim-refs.sh:43-45 (PRE_COMMIT mode scans whole file content, not a diff)

### 2. Incident Overview
* Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker (autonomous dogfood discovery during 29e7->main, PR2 #632)

#### Expected Behavior
A pre-commit hook should flag only violations INTRODUCED by the commit. On a merge commit that integrates main into a staged branch, pre-existing main content must not be re-flagged.

#### Actual Behavior
Merging origin/main into the staged branch surfaced 39 PRE-EXISTING main shim patterns ($PLUGIN_SCRIPTS / ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in plugin SKILL.md files) as violations — none introduced by the change (files byte-identical to main). The commit was blocked; required SKIP=shim-refs-check (a safety-net bypass). check-shim-refs.sh scans full file contents with no diff-vs-merge-base and no merge-commit skip. Local-only hook (NOT a CI/required check), so it does not gate main — but it normalizes the SKIP= bypass. Fix direction: scope to newly-introduced lines (diff added lines) or skip when git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD succeeds.
data.title: [check-shim-refs]: whole-file scan on merge commits flags pre-existing main violations -> false block
